description: Tool to run a GA4 funnel report. Use when you need a customized funnel analysis report for a given property. Funnel step sequence is determined by step attributes in the response, not row order.

inputSchema.description: Request model for running a GA4 funnel report.

dateRanges.description: List of date ranges to read; overlapping ranges duplicate days across ranges.

endDate.description: End date of the report range. Format YYYY-MM-DD or relative (e.g., 'today', '1daysAgo').
endDate.title: End Date

name.description: Optional user-defined name for this date range.
name.title: Name

startDate.description: Start date of the report range. Format YYYY-MM-DD or relative (e.g., '7daysAgo', 'today').
startDate.title: Start Date

dateRanges.title: Date Ranges

funnel.description: Funnel configuration object. Must include a 'steps' key with at least one step. Each step requires a 'name' and optionally a 'filterExpression'. Use 'funnelEventFilter' for event filters and 'funnelFieldFilter' for field filters. Filter expressions with 'fieldName' + 'stringFilter' are auto-wrapped in 'funnelFieldFilter'. Example: {"steps": [{"name": "First visit", "filterExpression": {"funnelEventFilter": {"eventName": "first_visit"}}}]}
funnel.title: Funnel

funnelBreakdown.description: Breakdown dimension configuration for the funnel table sub-report. The 'breakdownDimension' is a GA4 Dimension object whose field is 'name' (NOT 'dimensionName'). Example: {"breakdownDimension": {"name": "deviceCategory"}, "limit": "5"}.
funnelBreakdown.title: Funnel Breakdown

funnelNextAction.description: Next-action dimension configuration for the funnel visualization sub-report. The 'nextActionDimension' is a GA4 Dimension object whose field is 'name' (NOT 'dimensionName'). Example: {"nextActionDimension": {"name": "eventName"}, "limit": "5"}.
funnelNextAction.title: Funnel Next Action

limit.description: Number of rows to return. Default 10000; max 250000.
limit.title: Limit

property.description: GA4 property resource name, format: properties/{property_id}.
property.title: Property

returnPropertyQuota.description: If true, includes the property's current quota state.
returnPropertyQuota.title: Return Property Quota

segments.description: Up to 4 segments; each yields its own row in the report.
segments.title: Segments

inputSchema.title: RunFunnelReportRequest

name: run_funnel_report

propertyQuota.description: Snapshot of the property's quota for this request (only returned if returnPropertyQuota is true).
propertyQuota.title: Property Quota
